basis: Kit-based: champion kits and how each champion plays in a draft (ability interactions, CC setup and follow-up, lane priority, roams, engage and peel, damage profile, scaling). Gol.gg and DPM.LOL were not readable when the records were written and DPM has no duo data in this repo, so no proposal relies on a statistic. Pro games are shown beside a proposal only when a recorded game has the pair. Written by Claude (internal note).

records.identity: Engage tank: the W-Q headbutt combo starts fights on demand, and the same combo peels divers off his carry.

alternatives.reason: Lucian's dash and double-shot burst follow Alistar's level 2 combo, giving the lane early kill pressure.

preferred.reason: Cataclysm walls a group in and Alistar chains Pulverize inside the arena for a long layered lockdown.
